sentences.en: Sami wanted to know how to purify himself as a Muslim.
sentences.zh: 萨米想知道作为穆斯林如何净化自己。

sentences.en: Some animists think that a great fire should purify this world.
sentences.zh: 一些 Animist 认为一场大火可以净化这个世界。

sentences.en: I do not degrade you. I purify you.
sentences.zh: 我并没有贬低你，而是净化了你。
